$description: DragHandle (platform/components/DragHandle), library wave 10, lane A: its component tokens. The dashboard grid's handle look (the inline control size, the muted icon, the hover fill and the focus ring); picked up with the keyboard it takes the selected fill, as every pressed toggle.

drag-handle-size.$description: DragHandle: its width and height (the inline control size, 24px; larger with touch).

drag-handle-icon-size.$description: DragHandle: the drag icon in it (the inline control's icon).

drag-handle-radius.$description: DragHandle: its corners (the compact radius of small controls).

drag-handle-background.$description: DragHandle at rest: no fill; the icon alone shows it.

drag-handle-text.$description: DragHandle at rest: the icon in the muted content color.

drag-handle-hover-text.$description: DragHandle hovered: the icon at full strength.

drag-handle-pressed-background.$description: DragHandle while the pointer holds it: the pressed fill.

drag-handle-picked-background.$description: DragHandle while its item is picked up with the keyboard (aria-pressed): the selected fill.

drag-handle-picked-text.$description: DragHandle while its item is picked up: the selected content color.

drag-handle-disabled-text.$description: DragHandle disabled: the disabled content color.

drag-handle-focus-outline-color.$description: DragHandle focused with the keyboard: the focus ring's color.

drag-handle-focus-outline-offset.$description: DragHandle focused: the focus ring's offset.

drag-handle-focus-outline-width.$description: DragHandle focused: the focus ring's width.
